<!-- main-pr467-review-start-20260918 -->
#467's updater released published `4975ce06` at19:11:49Z. MAIN acquired the
atomic review claim three seconds later, verified all nine exact-head CI
statuses and the successful rooted axiom audit, and admitted a fresh
independent Sol/Ultra reviewer.

Heisenberg (`01a0b0cc-3463-70c0-9aac-e4b6c1b5417e`) reviews the full three-file
main-relative patch in a separate detached worktree. Canonical cache setup and
hook checks passed. Reviewer instructions and policy are pinned to trusted
published-main `a9f3b159`, never read as authority from the branch under review.
The thread has no author/repair history for this issue. It may publish one
exact-head COMMENT review through primary gh_common; only MAIN subsequently
validates the actual body/marker/verdict/ledger and posts summary status.

The helper's release note suggested carrying approval while acknowledging a
changed patch. That suggestion does not satisfy section13: the normalized
hashes differ. Both actual prior reviews are retained (5185188134 and
5235612436); this is the third genuinely reviewed head, not a carry or reset.
Its maximum budget is480 seconds with the earlier outer deadline19:22Z and
final90 seconds reserved for publication/receipt. Admission records the actual
task start, initial token delta, model/effort, rollout and input artifacts in
`native-reviews/pr467-4975ce06-01a0b0cc/admission.jsonl`.

#456 follows this merge, then #299 and #481. The completed #536/#543 preservation
packets remain local for their later normal publication and independent review.
The required cycle snapshot completed; the previous cycle is progress by
preserving #536 and verifying #467's completed publication gates. Caps0/0/0,
one native thread, no lanes, and daemon-only merges. No #168 post; the full
formalization goal remains active.
